usage: workflow open [-h] [--roots ROOTS] [--create] [--root ROOT] [--force]
                     [--skip-sync] [--format {text,shell}]
                     name

Resolve or create a project across repo-owned workspace roots. Use `--roots`
only to override the repo-owned workspace roots for this command.

positional arguments:
  name                  Project directory name

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --roots ROOTS         Override the repo-owned workspace roots for this
                        command (repeatable)
  --create              Create the project if it does not exist
  --root ROOT           Creation root for a missing project
  --force               Forwarded to `workflow init` during creation
  --skip-sync           Forwarded to `workflow init` during creation
  --format {text,shell}
